messages:
micah: Quick sync: scorecard row density on Prompt Sets scorecard view. User research shows people want more columns visible for quick triage. Current table packs two metrics and a long prompt title.

rene: We tried compact vs comfy in the last prototype. Compact squeezes titles and hides model tags. Proposal: introduce a "Triage mode" toggle that prioritizes metric columns over prompt title, and a hover-to-expand title preview.

jia: Accessibility: ensure keyboard users can expand the title preview. Use a button with aria-expanded that reveals the full prompt in a popover. Popover should trap focus while open.

oliver: From perf side, virtualized rows already exist. Adding hover expansion for 5k rows might be expensive. Suggest only enable expansion on demand (click to open) for very large datasets.

ux-bot: heuristic-scan: table row touch targets < recommended 44px on mobile in current mock. Flagging mobile adjustments.

micah: For triage mode layout: columns: [severity icon, prompt title (short), last run delta, pass rate, failures count, baseline link]. Allow column reorder and pinning.

rene: Microcopy: change 'pass rate' -> 'Success rate' across the console for consistency. Also rename 'failures' -> 'Examples failing'.

jia: For screen readers: table header cells need aria-sort for sortable columns and descriptive labels like 'Success rate, sorted descending'. Also announce when column visibility changes.

oliver: Implementation note: we can lazy-load heavy metric widgets (sparklines) only on hover or in expanded view. In triage mode show a compact number + delta chevrons instead.

micah: Visual suggestion: use subtle dividers and reduce vertical padding from 12px -> 8px in triage mode. Also increase contrast of severity icon background for a11y.

rene: New keyboard shortcuts proposal: 'g t' to toggle triage mode, 'p' to pin/unpin column under focus. Need to check conflicts.

jia: Add an 'announce' banner when users toggle triage mode for assistive tech: "Triage mode enabled, layout optimized for quick metric scanning" with a dismiss button.

micah: Decision: implement Triage mode (default off), hover/click title expand with aria-expanded, rename copy to 'Success rate' and 'Examples failing', reduce row padding in triage, lazy-load sparklines, and add a11y announcements + mobile touch target fix.

oliver: I'll scope the change into two PRs: UI + perf. Will include benchmarks.

rene: Action items: @micah finalize designs, @jia add aria attributes, @oliver work on lazy-loading, @ux-bot add checklist.

micah: Nice. Also add quick keyboard help under the table header: a small info icon with the list of shortcuts.
